sections.title: 1. What this doc is and how it was built
bullets: Last of 6 case-study docs (3a–3f). Same format as before. Covers H2 Topic 3.2 and H1 Topic 1.2 (same content).

20 case-study slots: 8 for the science (past variability, natural factors, IPCC consensus, carbon cycle, greenhouse effect, feedbacks), 6 for effects, 6 for responses. 'Key actors' has one case each for an NGO, a firm and a partnership; 'varying success' has a succeeded and a failed case. 21 cases, 22 pages.
Built with tools/build_case_studies.py from tools/data/case_studies_3f.json; charts 3_2_*.png; checked with tools/check_docx.py.

sections.title: 2. Assumptions
bullets: Science slots use recent events or reports as the 'case' (e.g. the 2025 ice core, the 2019 solar minimum, the 2021 IPCC report), since the syllabus points are about processes.
Process explanations (ice–albedo feedback, how the AMOC works, aerosol cooling) are standard syllabus knowledge rather than taken from the listed sources.
Same limits as before: no photos, and figures come from search results quoting each source.

rows: AMOC
'About 15% weaker than ~1,600 years ago' — press coverage also says '1,000-year low'; the source study year is unclear in coverage.
Greenland
532 billion metric tonnes (some outlets say 586 billion short tons — same amount, different units).
Mauna Loa
May 2023 value (424.0 ppm) is worked out from 'May 2024 was 2.9 ppm higher'.
IMO 2020
Warming effect is uncertain: +0.046°C in one model, no clear global effect in another.
Black Summer
Animals 1–3 billion and area 18.6–33.8 million ha depending on source.
Tuvalu
Applicants about 8,750 (one analysis) vs 1,466 registrations (another, counting family groups).
Ørsted
'CO2 per kWh 2018 = 28' is from 'cut 72% since 2009'; renewables 75% of output in 2018 (not the 86% sometimes quoted for 2019).
Costa Rica
'~99% renewable electricity' is the environment minister's figure; the plan says over 95%.
Slot 16 (adaptation)
Singapore's coastal protection. Alternative: Bangladesh cyclone shelters (a lower-income case).
Slot 20 pair
Costa Rica (succeeded) vs US Paris exits (failed). Alternative failed case: Indonesia's JETP (already slot 19).
H1 coverage
3e and 3f cover H1 Topics 1.1 and 1.2. H1 1.1.1 'What is SD' is in 3a slot 1.

sections.title: 5. To consider
bullets: All six docs are now built (3a–3f, 107 cases). A one-page index of all cases (case × slot × 'also fits') would help revision.
Same check before any future change: tools/check_docx.py on every new docx.
